description: Read up to 5 different sites or social profiles together with uploaded files (up to 200 files, 200 MB total, 25 MB per file) and optional local style files in repo. One daily import, one review and one private draft, never a redesign. Read with get_folder_import, choose sources where findings differ and confirm with apply_import. Upload files first with create_upload and complete_upload. A failed link does not discard other sources: retry only failed links with retryOf. Retries keep successful reads and do not use another daily import. Every provider read and model call is logged and budgeted. Nothing is public until approval.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you make up for this call. Send the SAME one again after a lost answer to get the first answer back, with nothing spent twice.
